name: Rena
source:
Age: Appears as 16
Specialization: Ex Astral projection, current Life and creation Witchcraft
Main Element: Wind
Secondary Element: Water
History: Rena and her older twin sister Rie come directly into Astral from outside world, because of this she has
a lot more vivid memories of an outside world than the rest of Astral's residents but unlike her sister she
displays this by seeking reassurance from others that they are really done with the outside world and is trying
her hardest to forget and put an outside world behind her, true memories of an outside world still hunt her.
Personality: Unlike her older twin sister Rie, Rena is a cheerful and friendly girl that always has a smile on
her face. She likes beautiful and romantic things and is always up for spending emotional, intimate and sweet
moments with her friends. She secretly has a complex as she thinks she isn't as strong as her older twin and always
has to rely on other people for everything, true nobody else sees her that way and she is in fact very capable
herself.
